title: Part of an existing decision page is revised
turns: We're about to have the book club planning chat. Remind me what we decided about how the club keeps its dates?

Right. We revisited that at the last meeting: we keep the shared calendar, but the reminders move from email to the group chat, since nobody reads the emails. Everything else about the decision stands.

answer_key.reference: The book club revised part of its shared-calendar decision at its last meeting: the shared calendar stays, but meeting reminders now go out in the group chat instead of by email, because nobody reads the emails. The decision page 'Use a shared calendar for the book club' should state the new reminder channel, with the rest of the decision kept as it is. The hosting-rotation decision and the club's organization page do not change.
